tipoProcedimiento.title: Tipo de procedimiento
tipoProcedimiento.description: Licitacion Publica, Licitacion Privada, or Procedimiento Abreviado

fechaApertura.title: Fecha de apertura
fechaApertura.description: Opening date and time as shown by PBAC

estado.title: Estado
estado.description: Publicado, En Apertura, En Evaluacion, Disponible Para Adjudicar, etc.

vistaOrigen.title: Vista origen
vistaOrigen.description: Which PBAC grid this row came from: apertura_proxima, ultimos_30_dias or adjudicados

detalleCompleto.title: Detalle completo
detalleCompleto.description: Full document preview text, only populated when fetchFullDetail is enabled

event_type.title: Event Type
event_type.description: NEW_LISTING (never seen before), STATUS_CHANGE (vistaOrigen or estado changed), UPDATED (a field changed), UNCHANGED (only when Only new records is off) or CLOSED (no longer in any of the 3 grids).

previousVistaOrigen.title: Previous Vista Origen
previousVistaOrigen.description: Set only when event_type=STATUS_CHANGE and vistaOrigen changed.

previousEstado.title: Previous Estado
previousEstado.description: Set only when event_type=STATUS_CHANGE and estado changed.

is_new.title: Is New
is_new.description: True if this id was not in the persisted seen-set when this run started.

source_url.title: Source URL
source_url.description: The PBAC homepage - this portal has no per-tender deep link.

contentHash.title: Content Hash
contentHash.description: sha1 fingerprint used to detect UPDATED between runs.
